OPTN KDPI and EPTS mapping tables

Source: R/optn_mapping_tables.R
optn_mapping_tables.Rd

The tables OPTN publishes for turning a scaled KDRI into a KDPI and a raw EPTS into an EPTS score, one per year, as used by add_kdpi() and add_epts(). Each table is a list of intervals: a value maps to the percentile of the interval with lower < value <= upper.

Format

A list of three tibbles:

tables

One row per table: score ("kdpi" or "epts"), label, reference (donor recovery year for KDPI; snapshot date for EPTS), data_as_of (OPTN database date printed on the table), scaling_factor (median KDRI_RAO of the reference donors; not printed on the 2010 and 2011 tables), diabetes_pct and hypertension_pct (percentages of reference donors, used by OPTN for unknown history; printed from 2014), kdri_formula ("rao2009" or "refit2024"), formula_basis, and the source file, url and sha256.

rows

One row per interval: score, label, row, lower, upper and percentile.

effective

When each table took effect in allocation: score, label, kdri_formula, effective_from, basis and stored. The basis is either an OPTN publication or, where none was found, the June 1 deadline in OPTN Policy 8.4.B, labelled as a convention. It includes the 2024-donor KDPI table (label = "2024-donors", stored = FALSE), so the period when that table was in force is known.

Source

OPTN KDRI-to-KDPI and EPTS mapping tables, retrieved 2026-11-16 from https://www.hrsa.gov/optn/data/allocation-calculators/archived-allocation-calculator-resources and the current tables linked from the OPTN KDPI and EPTS guides. Parsed by data-raw/optn_tables_parse.R; each file's address and sha256 are in data-raw/optn-tables/manifest.csv.

Details

Tables are labelled as OPTN labels them. A KDPI table's reference population is the deceased kidney donors recovered in one year, and its label is usually that year. The exception is the table labelled "2024": it re-maps the 2023 donors (OPTN data as of 2024-09-06) with a different scaling factor from the "2023" table, shortly before the refit KDRI took effect on 2024-10-31, and is taken to be the first refit table. OPTN does not say this on the table, so formula_basis records it as an inference. The table built from 2024 donors (scaling factor 1.40436817065005, cited in the OPTN KDPI guide) is not in OPTN's archive and is not stored. An EPTS table's label is the year of its December 31 waiting-list snapshot. The newest table of each kind is labelled "current".
